description.zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh: 单次请求获取最大RD成员账号个数，取值1-100整数。不传时默认取值20。
description.en: The maximum number of RD member accounts to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 请求Token，首次请求不传或者传空字符串。
description.en: The token for a paged query. If this is your first query, leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 查询指定堡垒机实例中已导入的RD成员账号列表（仅支持V3.2.48及以上版本使用）
